name: Service Line Material Widget Redesign
precondition: Tester has PWS credentials with access to the Service Lines page and to a service line inventory that contains at least one "in service" status line with associated materials. Tester also has ConfigCat access to toggle the "DataQuality" feature flag for the test account/environment. The "DataQuality" feature flag is initially OFF for the test account.
objective: Validate that the redesigned Service Line Material widget on the Service Lines page is gated by the "DataQuality" feature flag (ConfigCat) and, once enabled, renders "in service" status lines as bars around a circle (donut/radial chart) that filter the inventory table when a bar or a specific material line item is clicked.

steps.expectedResult: User is on the PWS home/dashboard.
Service Lines page is displayed; the Service Line Material widget is not visible/enabled because the "DataQuality" feature flag is OFF.

steps.step: In ConfigCat, enable the "DataQuality" feature flag for the test account, then perform a hard reload of the Service Lines page
steps.expectedResult: The Service Line Material widget becomes visible and enabled, showing "in service" status lines as bars arranged around a circle (donut/radial chart).

steps.step: Click one of the bars (status lines) arranged around the circle
steps.expectedResult: The inventory table below the widget filters to show only materials that are "in service" and match the clicked bar's category.

steps.step: Click a line item displaying the material name and count (e.g., "Copper 42")
steps.expectedResult: The inventory table filters to show only that specific material.
